title: Nereis Hero — Full World Room Spatial Contracts
scope: All A0-A13 and H01-H08 room IDs; coordinates are construction specifications pending Godot traversal acceptance.

landmarks.purpose: distant exploration goal; communicate next layer

landmarks.purpose: distant exploration goal; communicate next layer

rooms.title: 村庄街巷

landmarks.purpose: orient_player_to_north_east
deep_vertical_route

route_contracts: Street path must not be a flat uninterrupted corridor; use broken paving, house thresholds, low roof hops and a readable well mouth.
The well drop must be visually readable from the street but must not accidentally catch the player on decorative collision.
C02 and C24 must be distinct entrances with independent unlock behavior.

rooms.title: 老井竖井

landmarks.purpose: tease_hidden_well_route
downward_link_to_old_reservoir

route_contracts: The shaft must be traversable downward with safe landing pockets and visible ledges; do not make it a straight elevator corridor.
The bottom return to the village and the C06 watergate route must be spatially distinct.
H01 is optional and must not block reaching the bottom or returning.

rooms.title: 北门高路

landmarks.purpose: show_later_route_goal
long_term_exploration_goal

route_contracts: This is an elevated route with a controlled drop to the village/old drain, not another horizontal hallway.
The far city silhouette is background-only until the actual A3/A5 route is opened.

rooms.title: 雾林下层

landmarks.purpose: attract_player_to_upper_route
tease_later_ability_route

route_contracts: Use root arches and floor-height changes to create a winding path; the player should not see both exits as adjacent door markers.
The upper route should be visible from below but require a climb around the root mass.

rooms.title: 钟墓回廊

landmarks.purpose: central_vertical_landmark
future_return_target

route_contracts: The bell mechanism visually links the upper and lower chamber levels; the route bends around it.
H02 remains optional and returns to A2; it must not become a required C02/C03 gate.

rooms.title: 旧朝圣高路

landmarks.purpose: show_C04_destination_before_unlock
spatial_orientation

route_contracts: C04 should be a route opened from the far side or by progress; before opening, the destination is visible but not traversable.
The return route to A1 must remain distinct from the C04 path.

rooms.title: 坍塌街区

landmarks.purpose: hint_H03_without_revealing_it
tease_C16_return_shortcut

route_contracts: This hub needs at least three spatially distinct routes: street, elevated facade walk and drainage drop.
The C24 return to A1 must not overlap C08's battlefield entrance trigger.
The old lift is a visible landmark, not an immediately usable door.

rooms.title: 旧市场上层

landmarks.purpose: hint_hidden_third_street
long_range_navigation

route_contracts: The market roof route reconnects to the street and gives a higher approach to the battlefield link.
H03 is a concealed seam embedded in the environment, not a glowing marker.

rooms.title: 排水暗巷

landmarks.purpose: show_remote_lift_mechanism
connect_visual_language_to_A4

route_contracts: This is a vertical route network, not one uninterrupted sewer corridor.
C10, C16 and C24 must use separate spatial anchors and preserve their existing progression flags.
A shortcut opened here must materially reduce travel between A3 and its destination.

acceptance: Each room has at least one safe spawn support surface and an explicit return/forward route.
No exit trigger overlaps another exit trigger or a lethal fall zone.
All named one-way platforms have collision and visual edges aligned.
Visible locked routes are readable from the intended approach but cannot be entered before unlock.
Test normal jump, fall, backtrack, checkpoint recovery, and scene transition with the real Hero controller.
These contracts are not evidence of implemented scenes or runtime success.
